question: What is the role of the Cost-Based Optimizer (CBO) in relational engines?
category: What is the role of the Cost-Based Optimizer (CBO) in relational engines?

options.text: It explores equivalent relational algebra query execution plans and estimates their execution cost (I/O + CPU) to pick the cheapest plan.
It builds optimal join plans bottom-up for sub-relations of size $k$, pruning sub-optimal permutations based on cost and interesting sort orders.
Nested Loop: for each outer row, scans inner (fast with inner index); Hash Join: builds hash table on smaller relation, probes with larger; Sort-Merge: sorts both relations, merges linearly.
Statistical summaries in pgstatistic estimating value distribution and selectivity for WHERE clause predicates.

explanation: It explores equivalent relational algebra query execution plans and estimates their execution cost (I/O + CPU) to pick the cheapest plan.
